facts.fact: The Court of Accounts says the interior ministry's integrated human-resources information system, put into official operation under instruction 4315 of 22 May 2019, was placed at all communes and wilayas to gather commune staff data in real time, giving the ministry real-time centralised sight of commune staff; found in its audit of 25 communes covering 2019 to 2024.

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts says the interior ministry's human-resources application was placed 'at all communes and wilayas' to gather commune staff data in real time; it gives no numerator or denominator, and the count of 1,541 communes appears elsewhere in the report, in the ministry's reply on public lighting.

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts found the commune of Bouira using 55 applications, 41 of them the interior ministry's, among them the biometric e-counter, the civil-status counter, residence card, vehicle registration, driving licence, elections, budget management and payroll, with 25 used by its two biometric services; audit of 2020 to 2023 with a site visit in September 2023.
facts.system: internet connection of the commune of Bouira

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts says the commune of Bouira has no intranet and instead linked the floors of its building to the internet by Wi-Fi, which raised the commune's annual internet subscription costs and left access difficult because of weak throughput; site visit in September 2023.
facts.system: internet connection of the commune of Bouira

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts says the commune of Bouira bears annual internet subscription costs, which rose after it linked its floors by Wi-Fi; no amount is given; site visit in September 2023.
facts.system: internet connection of the commune of Bouira

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts describes the commune of Bouira's internet access as set up and paid for by the commune itself, maintained by its own IT service of 16 staff under the general secretariat; site visit in September 2023.
facts.system: internet connection of the commune of Bouira

facts.fact: The Court of Accounts describes the internet connection of one commune, Bouira, a wilaya seat outside the capital, in the one management audit of its 2025 report that examines a commune's information systems; site visit in September 2023.

note: Passages only. The report never states how communes in general are connected; the human-resources facts rest on the study's rule that working in a national system in real time states a connection, and the share:100% is the Court's 'all communes', not a counted figure. The public-lighting application is logged as a system only: the report does not say whether commune data reach the ministry online.
